mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the water was most worthwhile because the result explained that clearer water can still contain harmful microbes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling and then covering the jar felt predictable, though both actions served the goal.

surprise.text: The reminder that filtered water may still contain microbes sharpened my understanding of why boiling followed.

arbitrary.text: Combining the filter bed with a hollow pipe made a water filter, but the pipe's role in that assembly was not explained.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the practical distinction between filtering, boiling and separating used water made the straightforward combinations more interesting.
